preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 1000.
Matrix size is between 1 and 100 for each test case.

preconditions.expression: for each test case, b is an n x n binary matrix
preconditions.description: Each element of the matrix is either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: for each test case, output n lines
postconditions.description: Each test case has n lines of output.

postconditions.expression: for each line i, 1 <= s_i <= n and s_i distinct integers from 1 to n
postconditions.description: Each line starts with an integer s_i representing the size of the set A_i, followed by s_i distinct integers from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: for all pairs (i, j) satisfying 1 <= i, j <= n, b[i][j] = 1 if and only if A_i is a proper subset of A_j
postconditions.description: The binary matrix b correctly represents the proper subset relationship between sets A_i and A_j.
